schema:
CREATE TABLE Subscriptions (sub_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, created_date DATE, updated_date DATE, signup_date DATE);
CREATE TABLE Renewals (renewal_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sub_id INTEGER, renewal_date DATE, FOREIGN KEY (sub_id) REFERENCES Subscriptions (sub_id));
correct_query: SELECT STRFTIME('%d', T2.renewal_date) - STRFTIME('%d', T1.signup_date) FROM Subscriptions AS T1 INNER JOIN Renewals AS T2 ON T1.sub_id = T2.sub_id WHERE T1.sub_id = 10;
